method: Same movement features as the live Profit Radar scorer (backend/services/profit-radar/intentScorer.js: extractFeatures): mean speed, share of time still (< 0.1 m/s), share of micro-movement (0.02–0.15 m/s), straightness, U-turns (heading change > 120°), revisits (0.5 m grid). Here they are computed offline on 1-second steps (10 Hz averaged per second, to remove sensor jitter) inside 5-second windows, per vendor id.
